params.body:
The calm layer went amber this morning: `repos-sync` reset sportbusinessgame to `origin/master`, a branch that `--prune` had just removed after yesterday's rename to `main`. A clone remembers the default branch of the day it was made (`refs/remotes/origin/HEAD`) and fetch never updates that pointer.

Fix: ask the remote where HEAD points (`git remote set-head origin --auto`) on every sync before reading it; when the remote does not answer, read what the clone remembers rather than fail. One test with a bare repo whose default is renamed under a clone. Suite green, PHPStan and Pint clean.

The clone on the box heals itself on the next sync after this deploys; no hand on the server needed.
params.title: repos-sync follows a renamed default branch
